verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for a billing SaaS. The evidence pack only documents migrating data into Stripe (importing from Zuora, Recurly and others, plus the Billing migration toolkit). Nothing documents a bulk export of all account data in open formats or an exit path. General API access and webhooks are developer building blocks, not an export capability, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
